title: Sarkari Match post eligibility rule (v1)
description: One document per post per version. Filled by the LLM extractor, edited and published by a human reviewer. Evaluated by the deterministic engine in docs/backend/matching-engine.md, on the user's phone (the server publishes the document in the public catalog with `review` and `source.quote` stripped). Every fact carries a `source` (document + page) for provenance. Unknown/ambiguous facts must be expressed as `check_yourself`, never guessed.

evaluator_min_version.description: Lowest on-device evaluator (`:matching-core` EVALUATOR_VERSION) that understands every field used in this document. An app with an older evaluator shows the post as check_yourself with an 'update the app' line instead of guessing (matching-engine.md §4).

code.description: Stable code within the notice, e.g. 'CAPF-CT-GD' or 'UPP-CONST-CP'

short_name.description: ≤ 32 characters per locale, for notification titles and cards (e.g. 'SSC GD 2026')

allocation_basis.description: domicile_state: vacancies allotted by the candidate's domicile (SSC GD). Drives `vacancies_for_you` only, never eligibility.

exam_tags.description: Matched (overlap) against profile.interests.exam_types. Targeting, not eligibility.

state.description: For kind=state: alert users whose domicile or job_states include it

cutoff_date.description: Crucial date for determining age ('as on')

limits.description: Base limits. First row whose `when` matches applies; a row without `when` is the default. Example: UP Police male 18-22 / female 18-25.

max_convention.description: not_attained: candidate must NOT have attained max_years on cutoff (age < max; SSC/UPSC style: '18-23' prints window 02-01-2003..01-01-2008 for cutoff 01-01-2026). completed_years: completed age <= max. The validator derives which one the notice uses from printed_dob_window and blocks publish on mismatch.

general_extension_years.description: One-time relaxation for ALL candidates added to every max (e.g. UP govt +3 for UPP 2025). Added before category relaxation.

relaxations.description: Copy the notice's relaxation table row by row. Combinations (e.g. OBC+PwD = 13) are written as their own rows exactly as printed. Engine policy: among rows whose `when` matches, apply the single MOST BENEFICIAL one (highest resulting upper age). No implicit stacking.

mode.description: after_service_deduction: (age - military service) must be <= max + years (DoPT ex-servicemen rule).

absolute_max_years.description: Cap after relaxation, if the notice states one

needs_profile.description: Profile facts needed; if the profile cannot answer, the relaxation is shown as check_yourself instead of applied.

printed_dob_window.description: 'Born not before X and not later than Y' exactly as printed for the base (unrelaxed) limits. Validator recomputes it from cutoff_date + limits and blocks publish on mismatch.

codes.description: Taxonomy codes; a code matches itself and all descendants (grad.any matches grad.ba).

min_level.description: Alternative to codes: any qualification with taxonomy level >= this

include_higher.description: A higher qualification (higher level) also satisfies this alternative

when.description: Alternative applies only to these candidates (e.g. relaxed marks for SC/ST)

must_complete_by.description: Qualification must be acquired on/before this date

appearing_policy.description: Final-year/appearing candidates: not_allowed→fail; allowed→pass (provisional); if_passed_by_date→check_yourself unless result_date known.

equivalence.description: 'or equivalent' clauses: unlisted qualifications at the same level become check_yourself.

required_attributes.description: Extra certificates/skills (CCC, typing, NCC, TET, driving licence).

stage.description: Only at_application affects the verdict; others are advisory lines.

required_states.description: Only domiciles of these states may apply at all

category.description: Only for posts restricted to some categories (special recruitment drives). Normal reservation is NOT an eligibility rule.

eligible.description: false = post not identified suitable for PwD (PwD candidates cannot apply)

physical.description: Height/chest/run/eyesight: never in the profile; always rendered as an advisory 'check yourself' line that does not change the verdict.

other_conditions.description: Anything the schema cannot express. severity=check_yourself downgrades eligible→check_yourself for candidates matching `when`.

fees.description: First matching row wins; row without `when` is the default.

note.description: Optional fee line shown in 'what you need', e.g. 'Free for women, SC/ST and ex-servicemen'

LocalizedText.description: Text per BCP-47 locale. Supported: the 13 locales of docs/backend/data-model.md (as, bn, en, gu, hi, kn, ml, mr, or, pa, ta, te, ur). `en` is always required (universal fallback); the publish validator additionally requires every locale whose `locale.status` is `launch` (hi + en at launch). Other locales are optional and filled by the translation queue; clients fall back per `locale.fallback` (e.g. mr → hi → en, ta → en → hi).

quote.description: Short verbatim snippet for the reviewer

Condition.description: All present fields must match (AND). `any` = OR over sub-conditions. Category uses the EFFECTIVE category (OBC without non-creamy-layer → gen).
